definition: Revenue is a reported accrual-based line; customer cash collection and revenue timing remain distinct.
analytical_question: How do sales and cash timing differ?
positive_examples: A source-reported revenue line for a specified period.
counterexamples: Treating bookings or customer receipts as revenue.
interpretation_limits: Company recognition policy not yet audited.

definition: Operating profit and its same-period revenue denominator describe a reported margin.
analytical_question: How does operating profitability change on a compatible basis?
counterexamples: Dividing quarter profit by annual revenue or GAAP by non-GAAP input.
interpretation_limits: Company expense classification may differ; not return on invested capital.

definition: Net income and CFO are distinct reported flows; reconciliation needs disclosed noncash and working-capital adjustments.
analytical_question: What explains the gap between income and operating cash?
positive_examples: A disclosed cash-flow reconciliation with complete inputs.
counterexamples: Calling income minus CFO a fraud score.
interpretation_limits: No complete reconciliation or cash quality judgement without inputs.

canonical_name: Cash capital expenditure and noncash acquisitions
definition: Cash PP&E purchase payments are separated from depreciation expense and noncash lease acquisitions.
analytical_question: What cash investment is deducted in project FCF?
positive_examples: Cash PP&E payments with explicit sign and identical period CFO.
counterexamples: Using all investing cash flows, depreciation or finance leases as cash capex.
interpretation_limits: Cash line inclusion varies; project FCF is not a company claim.

definition: Cash and assets are balance-sheet amounts at a reporting date.
analytical_question: What cash balance and balance-sheet scope was reported?
positive_examples: A date-stated cash and cash equivalents balance.
counterexamples: Treating total liabilities as debt or cash plus investments as cash equivalents.
interpretation_limits: Restricted cash and maturity composition not yet audited.

definition: Adjusted measures retain their company definition, included adjustments and reconciliation.
analytical_question: Are the same-name adjusted measures actually comparable?
positive_examples: Company definition and reconciliation explicitly retained.
counterexamples: Merging same-name FCF or operating income across definitions.
interpretation_limits: Company definitions and complete reconciliation require source confirmation.

definition: Capacity, production, shipment and sale status measure separate physical or economic stages.
analytical_question: Which product or relationship stage changed?
positive_examples: Reported shipment stage retained without revenue estimate.
counterexamples: Capacity expansion automatically becomes shipment/revenue growth.
interpretation_limits: No physical unit, yield, inventory or ASP inferred from financial data.
